title: Whether the map can live in a shared store
why: Answering through a link and the hosted page are built differently depending on it, and the first principle says no database.

suggestions.title: Files in git stay the only way; the overview across apps reads several repos
suggestions.why: Keeps every principle, but people without a repo stay out

suggestions.title: A shared store as an option at init, with .grndwrk/ as the agent's working copy
suggestions.why: Opens the map to people and systems without a repo; the commands stay as they are

suggestions.title: Not now: build answering through a link on the relay first
suggestions.why: Gives colleagues a way in soon, and the store can come later
